Cincinnati Animal CARE is committed to the safety, care, and protection of all animals in our community. Since our establishment in 2020, we have been a no kill organization that operates as Hamilton County's only animal shelter. 

The Foster Department prioritizes animal's care and wellness by allowing them to spend the time they are in the shelter's care in a home. We are so lucky to have the community we do; a community that has helped us save thousands of lives through fostering!

Learn more at cincinnatianimalcare.org/foster today!
